note: HexaLearn-promoted base/recipe memory — resolved dynamically by competence_signature, not a static node-class map. Grows as outcomes are promoted.
integrity_policy: Every entry declares `integrity`: 'measured' (sha256 is the real, verified digest) or 'unpinned' (sha256 is null — NOT yet measured). An unpinned entry is a candidate, not a lock: the fetch step MUST obtain the artifact, record its digest here and verify it before any training or binding. Never fetch-and-trust an unpinned entry. A placeholder digest is never shipped — an absent measurement is stated as null (red-team A8).
